disposition_reason: Tables 1 and 4 print median and quartile concentrations of 25 elements, including lead, cadmium, arsenic and mercury, in broiler liver, thigh and breast from experimental feeding groups.

study.design: meta-analysis of group-level element data from nine broiler feeding-experiment series (36 groups: 7 control, 29 experimental) linked to cecal microbiome
study.origin: experimental broiler chickens, Federal Research Centre of Biological Systems and Agrotechnologies, Orenburg, Russia
study.method: microwave HNO3 digestion; ICP-MS (NexION 300D) or ICP-AES (Optima 2000 DV); 25 elements
study.qa: Perkin Elmer calibration standards; no CRM or recovery reported
